_comment: Supported built-in speaker hardware. codec and subsystem are matched against the PipeWire alsa.components property (HDA:<codec>,<subsystem>,<revision>). subsystem null matches any laptop using that codec. device_file is relative to the factory settings root, or an absolute path to your own tuning file. Add local entries in ~/.config/nahimic-linux/devices.json; they take priority over this file.

devices.name: MSI Stealth 14 Studio A13VF (Realtek ALC274, Intel SOF)
